name: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.1
changelog: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.1! Features robust mouse cursor auto-hide (hidden on game startup, reveals on intentional mouse motion, cleanly hides after 2 seconds of inactivity with trackpad micro-jitter filtering), throaty 'VROOOOM' combustion turbo boost roar, 3D lowpoly vehicle models rendered from true top-down orthographic perspective, 10 complete stages, and title screen quit option.
